ArchitectPhoto.description: One photo's area and left-to-right place there, as the Architect named them; checked by the segment stage, not here.
ArchitectPhoto.title: ArchitectPhoto

ArchitectResponse.description: Correlated by list position; `ix_` ids are minted later by the segment stage (AD-18).
ArchitectResponse.title: ArchitectResponse

BuildView.description: `to_build_view(room, job)`: never a solution, a dry-run answer or a clue-to-answer pairing.
BuildView.title: BuildView

ClickBody.description: Client-posted; `t_ms` is stamped by the API at append.
ClickBody.title: ClickBody

Decoy.description: An accepted `decoy` edit folded into a session's effective Room (option A, Oct 22).
Decoy.title: Decoy

DryRunAnswers.description: A list, never a map keyed by puzzle id (AD-12).
DryRunAnswers.title: DryRunAnswers

HintReply.description: The answer to a `hint_request`: the current Rung through the Guide port, or the No-hint line at `rung` 0.
HintReply.title: HintReply

HintRequestBody.description: `puzzle_id` is always omitted by the client and resolved to the Active puzzle.
HintRequestBody.title: HintRequestBody

MaskPreview.description: Solution-free, served once the segment stage completes.
MaskPreview.title: MaskPreview

OrderBuffer.description: Armed only while `puzzle_id` is the Active puzzle; clicks are the buffer.
OrderBuffer.title: OrderBuffer

Placement.description: Tier 2 object pose in original-photo pixels (fal metadata, else hand-placed).
Placement.title: Placement

PlayPuzzle.description: No solution and no Rung text; Rung text reaches the client only in hint replies and `rung_changes[]`.
PlayPuzzle.title: PlayPuzzle

Profile.description:
The player profile as a whole: every `RoomResult` keyed by its `room_id`, plus the `Derived` block.

The browser owns it (AD-8); under cut 2 only, `GET|PUT /profile/<name>`
reads and writes it as `rooms/profiles/<name>.json` in Local mode.
Profile.title: Profile

RoomDraft.description: The Riddler's raw output, kept for provenance (AD-7).
RoomDraft.title: RoomDraft

RoomView.description: The only type a prompt builder accepts.
RoomView.title: RoomView

SentBack.description: The fixed messages that sent back one failed attempt.
SentBack.title: SentBack

SessionState.description: Replayed from the log; carries `cards`, never an edit or the event log.
SessionState.title: SessionState

Story.description:
The Room's wizard lines, written by the storyteller at build time or filled from the fixed templates (story mode, 29 Oct 2026).

`riddles` holds one entry per Puzzle, the exit last; the client adds the
where-line to an opening and a solve line itself.
Story.title: Story

StoryRiddle.description: The Riddler's two lines for one Puzzle: one to open it and one once it is solved; flavour only, never a place or an object.
StoryRiddle.title: StoryRiddle

Thresholds.description: The effective nudge threshold and Rung spacing, their 1x values and the threshold's source.
Thresholds.title: Thresholds

TricksterCard.description: The public card projection, `to_card_view(event)`: no payload or content field (AD-3).
TricksterCard.title: TricksterCard

TricksterCardEvent.description: Stored server-side only, with the full edit for the AD-12 fold; the client sees `TricksterCard`.
TricksterCardEvent.title: TricksterCardEvent

TricksterEdit.description: Lives in the session log only (AD-12); never returned by a route (AD-3).
TricksterEdit.title: TricksterEdit

TriggerEvent.description: One log event a `rung_change` names in `triggered_by`: its type and `t_ms`, never its payload (AD-3).
TriggerEvent.title: TriggerEvent

UseOnInput.description: No `puzzle_id`: the server resolves the puzzle from the pair.
UseOnInput.title: UseOnInput

ValidatorReason.description: Structured and token-free: the rule (or `edit_bounds`), the puzzle, the field and the fixed message (AD-3).
ValidatorReason.title: ValidatorReason
